description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ContentSets, which handles content set management within the HTMLPurifier library. It provides functionality for merging content sets from modules, generating child element definitions, and converting string representations of content into lookup arrays.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ContentSets
classes.description: A class that manages content sets for the HTMLPurifier library, allowing merging from modules, generating child definitions, and handling content model expansion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the content sets by merging provided modules and expanding lookup references.

methods.name: generateChildDef
methods.description: Generates a child element definition for a given element definition based on its content model.

methods.name: generateChildDefCallback
methods.description: Callback used to replace content model keys with their corresponding content set strings.

methods.name: getChildDef
methods.description: Creates and returns an appropriate child definition object based on content model type.

methods.name: convertToLookup
methods.description: Converts a pipe-separated string of element names into a lookup array.
